newsitem.title: JAPAN: Share prices need not guide tax policy--MOF quoted.
newsitem.headline: Share prices need not guide tax policy--MOF quoted.

text.p: A senior Finance Ministry official said on Friday that it was not necessary to consider revising Japan's securities transaction tax in the context of share price movements, Jiji news agency reported.

"It is not necessary to think about a revision of the securities transaction tax with regard to how share prices are moving," Jiji quoted Nobuaki Usui, director-general of the ministry's tax bureau, as telling a parliamentary panel.
Usui added that he wanted to decide policy in a timely fashion in the context of securities taxes overall.
Usui said late last month that Japan would consider reviewing its securities transaction taxes and capital gains taxes as part of an overall reform of its financial system.
But he said then that he wondered whether it was a good idea to review those taxes as a way to deal with daily price movements in Tokyo share prices.
